question: At the fixed no-pulse A11 trajectory's last tick before natural first crossing, do the same signed motor perturbation and its inverse make the first threshold crossing occur on different ticks?
why_next: A11 gave 22 versus 10 perturbed motor spikes, yet both pulse branches crossed the fixed 10-spike threshold on the same tick. A nearby state with a verified pre-intervention window count of 5 tests whether the earlier result was specific to the pulse state/readout margin.
hypotheses: H3: exogenous signed tags exist but may not track action time
H4: the readout may collapse different signed motor responses into the same crossing

state.parent_branch: A11 no_pulse, plasticity and subsequent exploration disabled
state.selection_rule: Exactly one neural tick before A11 no-pulse branch's already observed first natural crossing; no search over ticks or states

intervention.motor_ids: the same 32 synthetic motor IDs as A11
intervention.sign_stream: Reuse A11's exact saved per-motor sign vector (22 positive, 10 negative); inverse negates each sign. No redraw or seed choice.
intervention.injection: At the single pre-intervention tick only, replace the motor components of the already-computed external drive with 0, +20, 20*sign_j, or -20*sign_j. This is a diagnostic exogenous pulse, not a Bernoulli exploration event.
intervention.continuation: After that tick, continue the same note only until outcome 373 resolves with exploration_probability=0 and plasticity_enabled=false; preserve fixed game/readout/encoder/topology/weights.

local_tag: Use the same A11 causal presynaptic trace at the pulse times each injected motor sign, decayed with existing tau_eligibility to the first DOWN; no update is applied.
controls: All four branches share byte-identical pre-intervention checkpoint, RNG, weights, neuron/queue state, eligibility, predictor, game and readout. Only one-tick motor drive differs. Compare no-pulse branch exactly with A11's saved no-pulse continuation.
primary_endpoint: First motor on-threshold rise time in locked_signed versus locked_signed_inverse, on the 1000-us neural tick grid
secondary_endpoints: per-cell motor spikes and 20-ms signed response contrast

predeclared_interpretation.pass: Both signed branches retain first actions and both tag signs; signed 20-ms per-cell response contrast is positive; first on-threshold rises differ by at least 1000 us without silence.
predeclared_interpretation.fail: Either signed branch lacks both tag signs or the signed motor response contrast is nonpositive despite an audited intervention.
predeclared_interpretation.inconclusive: Both branches have signed tags and differential motor response but the first crossing remains on the same tick, or an action/silence switch makes signed timing incomparable.
predeclared_interpretation.scope: One state, one fixed sign vector and mirror. A pass shows timing identifiability here only, not a useful weight update, learning or M2.

do_not: no weight update or development training
no ideal press time to neural code
stop after this stage's result, audit and regression
